brief: A glass-style Home Assistant dashboard that builds itself from your home. The mark should feel calm and safe, stay clear of Home Assistant's house-and-nodes look and generic smart-home clichés, and work at 16 px in a browser tab or the HA sidebar.
criteria: Success: recognisable at 16 px, reads as calm and safe before it reads as tech, distinct from Home Assistant, works in one colour.

concepts.name: Lit Doorway
concepts.idea: A lowercase n drawn as an arched doorway with the door inside: shelter and home. On dark backgrounds the door lights up lime, a light left on.
rationale: Says safe and homely without a house outline, shield or wifi arcs
Soft symmetric arch on a flat base: stable, quiet, calm
Deep ink mark; lime only as the light, so the accent stays gentle
Small-size cut and pixel-grid favicon keep it an arch, not an m, at 16 px

recommendation: Lit Doorway in Nuvio Ink, with the lime door reserved for dark surfaces and the app icon.
next_steps: Swap docs/assets/logo-light.png and logo-dark.png for final/png/nuvio-horizontal(-on-dark).png
Add the icons/ set and head-snippet.html to the docs site; use the small cut in the HA sidebar
Run a trademark search before wider use
